claims.summary: The compiler varies default peer-evidence moves and lecture/exam retrieval-cycle language across lessons instead of repeating one long slide-deck tail.
Activity, example, and deep misconception closure notes now rotate lesson-specific anchors while preserving the same correction and classroom intent.
Voice-pass logs and downloaded package manifests now label the texture self-check as scoped to voice surfaces.
A focused regression compiles the audited four-lesson Psychology lecture/exam shape and rejects the repeated tails found in the downloaded ZIP.

carryForward.next: After Pages deploy, run the EduTool.dev audit loop again and confirm whether the same Psychology prompt reaches 100/100 with no digest caveat and texture at 100.
If texture remains below 100 after deterministic compiler variation, evaluate a whole-package texture repair pass that targets slide decks and lesson plans without adding broad provider cost.
